title: 経営品質マネジメント
subtitle: Quality Management for Business Excellence
educationalGoal: This course is for achieving the learning and educational goals of the Department of Management Informatics, "Basic Management Ability" and "Business Application Practical Ability". We will collect and analyze the vast amount of data accumulated in society to develop the ability to obtain information that is essential for business decision-making. Specifically, we will deepen our understanding of data analysis methods such as statistical quality control (SQC), multivariate analysis, and geographic information systems.
advice: Students learn theories and procedures to develop insights that dig deepinto social problems using the vast amount of public data accumulated in society. Since statistical quality control (SQC) and multivariate analysis are used practically, it is necessary to take business quantitative analysis and information mathematics B. In addition, since the number of public data containing location information has increased, we will deepen practical understanding of geographic information science. Since classes are conducted with lectures, exercises, and reporting, and materials are used in advance in the teaching material distribution system without using textbooks, close lying closely monitor the distribution status of teaching materials on the Student Portal. And, do not neglect the preparation of the delivered material.
requiredKnowledge: "Business Quantitative Analysis" and "Information Mathematics B" are the basic subjects of this course. Before you take the course, take the course and review it.
